description: The Librarian: on a schedule or telemetry-volume trigger, reads usage telemetry and eval-suite runs to propose and gate versioned upgrades to LiNKskills skills and tools.

routing.when_to_use: Invoked asynchronously by the studio scheduler (periodic 'dreaming'/curation cadence) or when a telemetry-volume threshold is crossed — NOT by a human asking mid-session. Do not trigger this skill reactively inside another task.
when_not_to_use: Do not treat YAML-only validation as launch readiness
Do not claim usable/certified without sealed receipts

verification_steps: Validate canonical Skill Pack / eval / execution-profile JSON
Confirm sealed executor receipts before certification
completion_criteria: Canonical v0.1 artifacts present and schema-valid
